program.section_heading: Paramedic Certificate of Achievement (ACADEMIC PROGRAM CODE: W036925D)
outcomes: Understand the roles and responsibilities of the paramedic within an EMS system.
Apply the basic concepts of development, pathophysiology and pharmacology to the assessment and management of emergency patients.
Establish and/or maintain a patent airway, oxygenate, and ventilate a patient.
Obtain take a proper history and perform a comprehensive physical exam on any patient, and

Integrate pathophysiological principles and assessment findings to formulate a field impression and implement a treatment plan for the following types of patients: trauma, medical, neonatal, pediatric, geriatric, chronically ill, and common-complaint.
Safely manage the scene of an emergency.
